tool.rpm_verify.title: RPM Verify
tool.rpm_verify.description: Read-only comparison of installed files against the rpm DB record, reporting modified files (permission/ownership/hash/md5/size/device/mtime/symlink/capabilities drift). In deployment, CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH lets it read root-only files for integrity checks (non-root, without full privileges).
tool.rpm_unchanged.title: RPM Unchanged
tool.rpm_unchanged.description: Read-only list of packages whose files match the rpm DB perfectly (vast majority of packages). In deployment, CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH lets it read root-only files for integrity checks (non-root, without full privileges).
tool.rpm_summary.title: RPM Summary
tool.rpm_summary.description: Read-only aggregate drift statistics: total packages, changed packages, changed files, plus top-50 changed package names. In deployment, CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH lets it read root-only files for integrity checks (non-root, without full privileges).
